reasoning_traces.think:
The operators define a dual framework: coverage liability and QB targeting behavior both influence WR target allocation. Mispricing emerges when P1 fails to cross-check these signals against corpus data. The failure mode is over-reliance on volume-based projections without accounting for defensive liabilities or QB tendencies. The duality lies in how coverage failure and QB preference jointly determine target share. Inverse correlation between coverage liability and target efficiency creates a predictable signal for gap-hunting. The breakdown regime occurs when either signal exceeds a threshold—either too much liability or too little QB focus—indicating mispricing. The retrocausal genealogy traces back to early 2020s fantasy analytics frameworks that used first-read data and defensive metrics. The theory of mind models opposing agents as QBs optimizing for completion rate and coaches adjusting WR roles based on coverage. Anti-collinearity vetos include ignoring route-run efficiency or failing to adjust for injury status.
